purpose: Bridge missing producer physical_case_id only from exact immutable generation-input and owner/control evidence.

identity_gate.bridge_authority: source_current physical identity plus exact source XML/BI4/receipt/Def/GenCase/runtime/dispatch hashes and one allowed Def dp change

domain_equivalence.resolution_difference: exactly one XML attribute at /case[0]/casedef[2]/geometry[0]/definition/@dp; positive finite values; all tags, children, text and other attributes equal
domain_equivalence.controls: candidate request sentinel, source Def hash, common control/runtime hashes and owner proof edges must agree; no label-only substitution
domain_equivalence.continuous_mass: ROOT252 owner mass remains a separate continuous target; native sample mass is never rescaled or promoted

worker_scope.eligible_case: one frame-0 BI4 plus Fluid/Bound VTK after parent guard

negative_cases: candidate generated XML/BI4 or producer receipt hash does not match source_current
candidate runtime/dispatch/GenCase hash missing or changed
more than the single approved dp attribute differs
wrong owner proof or missing control mapping
